title: Life on a Desert Island
question: What was exceptional about the two men's stay on the desert island?

meanings.usage: 修饰表示地点的名词，指地方荒无人烟
指干旱少雨、植被稀少的大面积荒漠地区
用来描述人或事物不同于普通情况，含褒义时表示非常优秀
通常用来描述想法、期望等不符合客观实际
可指宗教中的天堂，也可指令人愉悦的完美地方或状态
用来描述人的处境痛苦，或事物质量差、令人不满
不及物动词，可搭配to death表示饿死；口语中也可表示很饿
an element of 为常用搭配，表示“一点点，些许”
不可数名词，也可作定语修饰名词，如coral island（珊瑚岛）
常用搭配load sth with sth，表示“给某物装上某物”
可表示车辆、船只的装载量，也可指人的工作负担
指小型的敞篷船只，通常用桨或者马达驱动
可作定语构成复合词，如spear gun（捕鱼用的鱼枪）
可作可数名词指龙虾个体，也可作不可数名词指龙虾肉
指运输石油、天然气等液体的大型船只或车辆
用来修饰情感、态度，表示发自内心、没有虚假

phrases.usage: 表示对某事物形成某种想象或印象

examples.en: It's hard to form a clear picture of life on other planets.
examples.zh: 很难对其他星球上的生活形成清晰的想象。

phrases.usage: 用来表示不确定的描述，意为“某种，可以说是”，弱化语气

examples.en: The small café by the lake is a sort of paradise for book lovers.
examples.zh: 湖边的那家小咖啡馆可以说是读书爱好者的乐园。

phrases.usage: 固定搭配，表示饿死，强调极端饥饿的后果

examples.en: Many animals would starve to death in winter if they don't store enough food.
examples.zh: 如果没有储存足够的食物，很多动物会在冬天饿死。

phrases.usage: 表示“一点点，些许”，说明某事物中含有少量的某种特质

examples.en: There is always an element of risk when you travel alone.
examples.zh: 独自旅行的时候总会有一点点风险。

phrases.usage: 表示“给……装上……”，主语通常是人，宾语是装载的载体和货物

examples.en: They loaded the truck with fresh vegetables before dawn.
examples.zh: 他们在黎明前给卡车装上了新鲜蔬菜。

phrases.usage: 表示“几乎没有”，相当于very few或very little，否定含义

examples.en: There is hardly any coffee left in the pot, so I need to make more.
examples.zh: 壶里几乎没有咖啡了，我得再煮点。

phrases.usage: 非正式表达，意思是吃得非常好，享用美食

examples.en: During the Spring Festival, we eat like kings with all kinds of delicious food.
examples.zh: 春节期间我们吃得非常好，有各种各样的美食。

sentences.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人对荒岛生活形成了一种不切实际的想象。

sentences.en: We sometimes imagine a desert island to be a sort of paradise where the sun always shines.
sentences.zh: 我们有时把荒岛想象成一个阳光普照的天堂。

sentences.en: Life there is simple and good.
sentences.zh: 那里的生活简单而美好。

sentences.en: Ripe fruit falls from the trees and you never have to work.
sentences.zh: 成熟的果实从树上掉下来，你根本不用劳动。

sentences.en: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
sentences.zh: 而另一方面的情况却恰恰相反。

sentences.en: Life on a desert island is wretched.
sentences.zh: 荒岛上的生活是悲惨的。

sentences.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat which never comes.
sentences.zh: 你不是饿死，就是像鲁滨逊漂流记一样，苦等一艘永不来临的船。

sentences.en: Perhaps there is an element of truth in both these pictures, but few of us have had the opportunity to find out.
sentences.zh: 也许这两种景象都有点真实性，但我们很少有人有机会去证实。

sentences.en: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
sentences.zh: 最近，有两个人在一个珊瑚岛上待了五天，他们真希望能在那里待得更久。

sentences.en: They were taking a badly damaged boat from the Virgin Islands to Miami to have it repaired.
sentences.zh: 他们正驾驶一艘严重受损的船从维尔京群岛前往迈阿密修理。

sentences.en: During the journey, their boat began to sink.
sentences.zh: 旅途中，他们的船开始下沉。

sentences.en: They quickly loaded a small rubber dinghy with food, matches, and cans of beer and rowed for a few miles across the Caribbean until they arrived at a tiny coral island.
sentences.zh: 他们迅速将食物、火柴和几罐啤酒装上一艘小橡皮艇，划行了几英里穿过加勒比海，直到抵达一个微小的珊瑚岛。

sentences.en: There were hardly any trees on the island and there was no water, but this did not prove to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 岛上几乎没有树木，也没有水，但这并没有成为一个问题。

sentences.en: The men collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy.
sentences.zh: 两人用橡皮艇收集雨水。

sentences.en: As they had brought a spear gun with them, they had plenty to eat.
sentences.zh: 由于他们带了一支鱼枪，所以食物很充足。

sentences.en: They caught lobster and fish every day, and as one of them put it 'ate like kings'.
sentences.zh: 他们每天都捕捞龙虾和鱼，正如其中一人所说，他们“吃得像国王一样”。

sentences.en: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave.
sentences.zh: 五天后，当一艘过往的油轮救起他们时，两人都真诚地感到遗憾，因为他们不得不离开。

exercises.prompt: “悲惨的；可怜的；恶劣的” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: wretched · /ˈretʃɪd/ · adjective · 悲惨的；可怜的；恶劣的。用来描述人的处境痛苦，或事物质量差、令人不满

exercises.hint: 如果没有储存足够的食物，很多动物会在冬天饿死。

exercises.explain: The men collected rainwater in the rubber dinghy. — 两人用橡皮艇收集雨水。

grammar.title: wish引导的虚拟语气
grammar.definition: wish后面接宾语从句时，常使用虚拟语气，表示与事实相反或不太可能实现的愿望。如果是对过去情况的虚拟，从句谓语用过去完成时（had done）。
grammar.structure: 主语 + wish + 从句主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用来表达对过去已经发生的事情感到遗憾，希望事情是另一种情况

examples.en: Two men who recently spent five days on a coral island wished they had stayed there longer.
examples.zh: 最近在一座珊瑚岛上待了5天的两名男子真希望他们能在那儿待更久。

examples.en: I wish I had taken your advice when I was choosing my major.
examples.zh: 我真希望我选专业的时候听了你的建议。

grammar.title: either...or...并列连词结构
grammar.definition: either...or...是表示选择关系的并列连词，用来连接两个对等的成分，表示“要么……要么……；或者……或者……”，二者选其一。
grammar.structure: either + 成分A + or + 成分B
grammar.usage: 连接的成分可以是主语、谓语、宾语、表语等，连接主语时，谓语动词遵循“就近原则”，和or后面的主语保持一致

examples.en: You either starve to death or live like Robinson Crusoe, waiting for a boat which never comes.
examples.zh: 你要么饿死，要么像鲁滨孙·克鲁索那样生活，永远等着一艘永远不会来的船。

examples.en: You can either come with us to the park or stay at home to read books.
examples.zh: 你要么和我们一起去公园，要么待在家里看书。

grammar.title: as引导的方式状语从句
grammar.definition: as可以引导方式状语从句，表示“正如，如同，按照”，用来说明动作的方式或者某人所说的内容。
grammar.structure: as + 主语 + 谓语 + 其他成分
grammar.usage: 常用来引用别人的话，或者说明某个动作是按照什么方式进行的

examples.en: As one of them put it 'ate like kings'.
examples.zh: 正如他们其中一个人说的那样，“吃得像国王一样好”。

examples.en: As the old saying goes, 'Practice makes perfect'.
examples.zh: 正如老话说的那样：“熟能生巧”。

patterns.pattern: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of + 名词/名词短语.

original.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of life on a desert island.
original.zh: 我们大多数人对荒岛生活都抱有不切实际的想象。

examples.en: Most of us have formed an unrealistic picture of the life of celebrities.
examples.zh: 我们大多数人对名人的生活都抱有不切实际的想象。

examples.en: Many children have formed a romantic picture of studying abroad.
examples.zh: 很多孩子对留学的生活都抱有浪漫的想象。

patterns.pattern: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.

original.en: The other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
original.zh: 而另一种想象则完全相反。

examples.en: People always think being a teacher is easy, but the other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
examples.zh: 人们总觉得当老师很轻松，但实际情况恰恰相反。

examples.en: Advertisements make the product seem perfect, but the other side of the picture is quite the opposite.
examples.zh: 广告把这个产品说得很完美，但实际情况完全相反。

patterns.pattern: When + 时间状语从句, 主语 + be genuinely sorry that + 从句.

original.en: When a passing tanker rescued them five days later, both men were genuinely sorry that they had to leave.
original.zh: 5天后一艘路过的油轮救了他们，两人都由衷地感到遗憾，不得不离开那里。

examples.en: When the winter vacation came to an end, I was genuinely sorry that I had to go back to school.
examples.zh: 寒假结束的时候，我由衷地感到遗憾，不得不回学校了。

examples.en: When the party was over, all the guests were genuinely sorry that they had to say goodbye.
examples.zh: 派对结束的时候，所有客人都由衷地不舍，不得不互相道别。
